scripts.build: npm run build -w @emseepea/server -w @emseepea/example-ui-shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run decisions:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:examples && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/black-box/*.test.mjs tests/docs/*.test.mjs tests/llm/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:eval: npm run build && emseepea-test --provider claude-local examples/basic-no-ui/eval.yaml examples/backend-no-ui/eval.yaml examples/multi-instance/eval.yaml examples/native-ui/eval.yaml examples/protected-no-ui/eval.yaml examples/react-tailwind-ui/eval.yaml examples/resources-prompts/eval.yaml examples/streaming-progress/eval.yaml
scripts.test:eval:ci: emseepea-test --provider claude-ci examples/basic-no-ui/eval.yaml examples/backend-no-ui/eval.yaml examples/multi-instance/eval.yaml examples/native-ui/eval.yaml examples/protected-no-ui/eval.yaml examples/react-tailwind-ui/eval.yaml examples/resources-prompts/eval.yaml examples/streaming-progress/eval.yaml
